stayType: Harbourside hotel and spa on the Salcombe estuary (Harbour Hotels group)
accommodation: A choice of rooms and suites; room count not stated
suitableFor: Couples and spa breaks; not a surf-focused stay
beachAccess: On the Salcombe estuary at Cliff Road; the site mentions beach picnics and nearby watersports but gives no beach distance
confirmedFeatures: HarSPA with treatments and spa days, The Jetty seafood restaurant and bar with rooftop terrace overlooking the estuary, event spaces
overview: Harbour Hotel Salcombe stands on Cliff Road above the Salcombe estuary in South Devon, with a spa and a seafood restaurant with a rooftop terrace. It belongs to the Harbour Hotels group and is in Salcombe, not Bigbury-on-Sea.
surfTripFit: A comfortable estuary-side base for non-surfers and mixed groups. It is in Salcombe, so Bantham and Bigbury are a drive away rather than on the doorstep.
